WHY did James give the money to the store manager instead of keeping it?

Owen's class was choosing a name for the new class pet, a goldfish. Everyone had a different idea. Owen suggested "Captain Bubbles" and the whole class laughed and raised their hands. The teacher said it was the most popular choice, but Owen noticed his friend Maya had not raised her hand. After class he asked her what name she had wanted.

WHAT does Owen's behavior after class tell you about his character?
items.answer: Owen's behavior shows he is caring and considerate. Even though his idea won, he noticed Maya had not voted for it and made sure to ask her opinion, showing he cared about how she felt.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Amara always sat in the front row during science class because she loved being close to the experiments. When a new student, Deshi, came to class, the only open seat was in the back. Amara saw Deshi looking nervous and searching for a friendly face. Without saying a word, Amara picked up her things and moved to the back row, leaving her front-row seat for Deshi.

WHY did Amara give up her favorite seat, and what does this action tell you about her? Use evidence from the story.
items.answer: Amara gave up her favorite seat because she could see Deshi was nervous and needed a friendly face nearby. Giving up something she loved, the front row she sat in because she loved experiments, shows that Amara values making others feel welcome more than her own preferences. Her silent, selfless action reveals she is empathetic and kind.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Leo and his dad drove past the old park where Leo had learned to ride a bike three years ago. The park was being torn down to make room for a new apartment building. Leo said nothing in the car. That night he wrote a letter to the city explaining why the park mattered to kids in the neighborhood. He put the letter in the mailbox before breakfast the next morning.

WHAT does the detail about Leo mailing the letter "before breakfast" tell you about how he felt, and WHY is that detail important?
items.answer: The detail that Leo mailed the letter before breakfast shows how urgent and important the matter was to him. He wrote the letter the same night and sent it first thing the next morning without even waiting until after breakfast, which suggests he was determined and did not want to waste a single day. It shows he was deeply motivated by what he saw, not just briefly sad.
